title: Laboratory administration history
purpose: Read maintenance actions recorded by Django administration for this object.
summary: Read the maintenance actions Django administration recorded for this laboratory record, oldest first.

tasks.title: Read what changed and who changed it
steps: Read Date/time, User and Action for each entry.
Use the page numbers to move through older or newer entries.

tasks.title: Go back to the laboratory record
steps: Select the laboratory record in the breadcrumbs.

good_to_know: This shows only actions taken in Django administration.
Retention changes also have their own audit event, with the reason and the full statement before and after.
No change history does not mean nothing happened to the record.

sections.title: Access and scope
paragraphs: Requires active Staff status, Superuser status and the laboratory admin role.
Retention changes have a separate attributed domain audit event retaining reason and full before/after statement and revision.
Shows only this object’s Django administration LogEntry records, oldest action first, 100 per page. It is read only and is not a full scientific provenance or authentication-usage history.

items.label: Date/time
items.description: Administration action timestamp in the display time zone.

items.label: User
items.description: Acting administrator’s username and full name when present.

items.label: Action
items.description: Django’s rendered change message, usually added/changed fields. It is not a snapshot of every old/new value or the complete domain reason.

items.label: Numbered pages
items.description: Move through older-to-newer 100-entry pages with an entry count; no search or sort controls.

items.label: Home / app / model / object breadcrumbs
items.description: Return through the permitted maintenance hierarchy.

items.label: No change history
items.description: Explains that this object may not have been added through administration. Absence here does not mean no domain or self-service events exist.
